scope: Visual assembly review of all 488 final answer-key pages. Every final page was seen in a labelled whole-page contact and a native-pixel footer strip. All ten new or deliberately blank pages were additionally viewed as native full-page rasters. Retained header/body detail is inherited only from exact current accepted-source pixel matches.

reviewer_roles.prior_relevant_work: Reviewer authored the revised learner pronunciation guide and supplied source/dependency proposals, but did not author the full-key assembly or this new front matter.

method.contact: All 31 labelled sheets were actually viewed at original sheet resolution. Each page is reduced to 240 × 351 pixels; these are structural overviews, not claimed full-resolution readings of retained prose.
method.footer: All 21 labelled sheets were actually viewed at original resolution. Each page contributes its native 974 × 95-pixel footer strip from row 1328 through 1422, with every printed numeral checked against its physical-page/folio label.
method.new_pages: All ten raw combined-page rasters were actually viewed at their native 974 × 1423 pixels. Their page IDs were given in the tool output; the generated labelled full-size duplicate proofs were not needed or claimed as additional views.
method.retained_detail: All 478 retained pages must have current accepted-source master/TeX/PDF identities and exact decoded RGB equality for header/body rows 0–1327 inclusive. This preserves source tables and special glyphs without claiming that the reduced contacts newly establish every glyph.
method.cutoff: The comparison's full-width 224–226 mm guard band must contain no nonwhite pixel. Native footer views separately check everything below the comparison cutoff.
limitations: This is visual assembly acceptance, not a fresh linguistic solution of the keys.
Retained body/header details rely on the current accepted-source receipts plus exact raster equality; only new/blank pages were newly inspected at native full-page size.
PDF-link destinations and complete text/answer separation are validated by separate current checks; this receipt does not replace those checks.

footer_exclusion.guard_expectation: Every RGB channel is 255 in the full-width blank gap around the cutoff.
